plain_description.what: Audits the 10 certified splits of the main tree (bareq512). It checks whether any was created late, after the build had gone quiet, and whether any barely clears the minimum separation bar. No calls.
plain_description.why: The main tree turned out not to be a true fixed point, so its certified splits might come from late, unstable edits.
plain_description.information: If certified splits were late or borderline, the certified structure would be fragile. Result: none of the 10 were born late, and all sit 2.4 to 6.2 times above the bar. The certified structure is not a product of late edits. The tree is still not a certified fixed point, and the cluster-count side is undetermined.
